## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Related Issues

Closes #

Use `Closes #123` when merging this pull request should close a specific issue. Remove the placeholder if no issue applies.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or enhancement
- [ ] Refactoring or architecture
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or tooling
- [ ] Dependency, build, or configuration change
- [ ] Other

## Implementation Plan

Plan: `docs/plans/<plan-filename>.md`

- [ ] The implementation plan exists and reflects the agreed scope.
- [ ] The plan's TODO checklist has been updated by the implementing agent.
- [ ] Material deviations and unresolved tasks are documented.
- [ ] Required approvals were obtained.

Developers define requirements and author specifications. AI agents are responsible for drafting implementation plans and maintaining their TODO checklists. A plan does not itself authorize work requiring approval.

## Implementation Details

Summarize the approach, important decisions, and affected areas.

## Validation Evidence

List the checks actually performed and their results.

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant automated tests
- [ ] Relevant manual or device tests
- [ ] Failure paths and cancellation checked where applicable
- [ ] Dry-run behavior checked where applicable
- [ ] Destructive behavior tested safely, using mocks or disposable data where possible
- [ ] Not applicable, with explanation

Additional commands, results, and checks not run:

## Safety and Compatibility

- [ ] Backup source media remains protected.
- [ ] Destructive operations retain appropriate safeguards.
- [ ] Dry-run operations remain non-destructive.
- [ ] Filesystem paths and external command arguments are handled safely.
- [ ] Device selection and authorization remain correct.
- [ ] Relevant compatibility concerns have been considered.
- [ ] Not applicable.

Describe risks, limitations, or unchecked items.

## Documentation

- [ ] User or developer documentation updated where needed.
- [ ] Specifications updated if intended requirements changed.
- [ ] An ADR was added or updated if a significant architecture decision was made.
- [ ] No documentation changes were needed.

## Review Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff.
- [ ] No unrelated changes or secrets are included.
- [ ] The implementation matches the agreed requirements and scope.
- [ ] The plan reflects the actual implementation and verification state.
- [ ] Remaining limitations and follow-up work are documented.
